title: Non-collinear OPCPA in BBO
summary: A 15 fs, 50 nJ seed at 800 nm, stretched to about 0.6 ps, is amplified in 2 mm of BBO at the magic non-collinear angle (2.56°) pumped by the 515 nm second harmonic of the SHG example: it leaves with 43.7 µJ (gain 874, a 224 nm phase-matching bandwidth) and compresses to 24.0 fs, at its transform limit.
